author: Hank Green
description:
I decided against showing the increasingly unhinged takes that hit my Threads and Twitter feeds but, suffice to say, it is both easy, normal, and rewarded to have scary takes on the internet...let's try something different...looking at what we actually know (rather than what my brain is making up) and determining whether any of that is scary.
